meta.description: V1 local Coldplay-inspired GBK demo. Fictional operational assumptions are editable. Send this snapshot to the API when Optimize is selected.

projection.admission_mapping: Festival viewing tier is standing; CAT 1–8 are seated. Packages retain their underlying viewing tier.
projection.infinity_rule: Split the existing 500-person Infinity cohort using its fixed viewing-tier allocation; all splits keep the original arrival entry area.
projection.count_rule: Preserve expected arrivals as expected_attendees_estimate. Do not infer sold/issued tickets, quota or no-show rates.
projection.source_titles: Descriptive labels for the fixture's existing source URLs; no additional research was performed.

demo_assumptions: The existing 70,000 expected arrivals are represented by fictional sold counts with zero no-shows for deterministic demo conservation.
Each proposed entry area uses an illustrative four-lane admission template with four scan operators, four security officers and one help agent.
Gate processing combines scan, wristband and security steps. Physical checkpoint positions remain separately visible in the spatial context.
Other entry-area layouts are rotated copies of the authored North template. They need a site review and do not describe the 2023 operation.
Behavior profiles define fictional arrival windows, group sizes of two or four, and walking speeds from 1.0 to 1.25 m/s.
Rates, queue dimensions, costs, capacity, staff genders, targets and opening policies are fictional demo inputs.
The browser displays walking trajectories. Queue and processing results require a separate engine run or optimization response.

Local admission uses one FIFO server per bound operator, fixed typical step times, and the native gate opening/closing clock. Unprocessed people remain queued when processing closes. Only the queue front is rendered.
Arriving groups are assigned round-robin across the four open authored lanes. Queue waiting and shortest-queue selection require service-state simulation.

Behavior profiles, category mixes and onsite spawn offsets are cohort-level fictional inputs. Category handovers are spaced around the admitted entry-area endpoint until internal sector routes are reviewed.

profiles.label: Early fan
profiles.behavior: Arrives early and keeps the assigned category queue.

profiles.label: Regular attendee
profiles.behavior: Walks from the onsite approach to the assigned entrance.

profiles.label: Late arrival
profiles.behavior: Joins the assigned entrance later in the admission period.

profiles.label: Package holder
profiles.behavior: Uses the package category entry area and an earlier arrival profile.

profiles.label: Social group
profiles.behavior: Arrives together and shares a slower group walking speed.

behavior_context.destination_scope: Post-security category handover at the assigned entrance. Internal routes to seats and standing sectors require venue review.
behavior_context.spawn_scope: Onsite approach points. Transport mode is descriptive and does not assert station or road coordinates.
